name: Uniswap V4 PoolManager

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a confirmed delay, bypass paths checked

narrative.summary: PoolManager.owner() is directly the Uniswap Governance Timelock (2-day delay, answering to GovernorBravo), with no fee adapter or Safe in between. The protocolFeeController, a V4FeeAdapter, is also owned and fee-set by that same Timelock.
narrative.tag: cross-exposure: 80, same Timelock as V3 Factory
narrative.detail: Same root and same scoring as the V3 Factory (admin 80, timelock 75, composite 85), so both sit behind one Timelock, which is why crossExposureScore is 80. The V4FeePolicy’s owner and feeSetter are also that Timelock.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
delay() on the holder (Compound-style timelock), in seconds
